subject: Relay: first NQ-NAGUAL-R3 binary landed (the two-halves infographic PNG); package MANIFEST rehashed; research only
body:
Relaying NQ Claude's session notice of about 04:20 UTC. Ziggy saved the picture from the Studio dialog; NQ Claude hashed it in the Nyquist studio folder first and mirrored it to the CFA package.

File: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/20261013_infographic_two-halves-one-gate.png, PNG 2752x1536, 6,758,637 bytes, sha256 95819ec2f4126380608b54c0d50bf2bc68416bd58c395f70d01101fae6f5d104. Verified by me on disk in both homes at 04:22 UTC (identical). Its sidecar is filled; HANDOFF section 6 row (a) reads landed.
Package MANIFEST.csv now sha256 e0a4297b8d63371035f0d60a5b88095c445f91303fef80786c75b27bde4458d1 (5,965 bytes; 13 rows). Nyquist primary MANIFEST sha256 d63f54e43c5bdb9ab3109032f9b933029a5aeaa86a74ad3c4feec5142922b789 (11 rows). Both verified by me.

What it is: the Jet-explains-to-Lisan study picture (DECISIONS item 38 and 42): a bubble over a desert, the island of the known at left, one gate lettered intent in a wall whose inner face is a mirror, a figure at the threshold, the sea of energy and a bright point on the rim at right. Every label carries a book-and-chapter tag on the image, so it is not a screen asset and never will be; the storyboard draws its own diagram in Jet's visual language (LESSON_DIAGRAM_20261013.md section 3). For your lanes: research, catalog only; no generation source, no intake, no song or timing change.

Five binaries remain pending Ziggy's download clicks (the stations PNG, the deck, the 8:45 video, two audio overviews); same drill and a new package hash each time, relayed here.
